title: Timesheet mirror
subtitle: Cycle 26→25 (payroll closes on the 25th) — Portaria 671
periodHint: Competence = closing month. E.g. July = 26/06 to 25/07.
midPeriodHireHint: {{name}} hired on {{date}}: days before hire do not count as absence.
midPeriodTermHint: {{name}} terminated on {{date}}: days after termination do not count as absence.
selectEmployeeToLoad: Select an employee before applying filters.
idleHint: Choose the period and employee, then click Apply filters to load calculated days.
mirrorPdfPeriodRequired: Approve or lock the period before exporting the mirror PDF.
mirrorPdfNoDays: Apply filters and load the mirror before exporting the PDF.
mirrorPdfEmployeeRequired: Select an employee to export an individual mirror PDF.
mirrorPdfRequiresAllApproved: Approve all days in the period ({{pending}} pending) before generating the PDF.
ackBlockedAbsent: Cannot approve an absent day — add manual punches, register leave, or mark day off.
ackBlockedIncomplete: Cannot approve an incomplete day — complete punch pairs (e.g. missing Exit 2 / end-of-day out). A full workday requires 4 punches.
ackBlockedNeedFourPunches: A full workday requires exactly 4 punches (In 1, Out 1, In 2, Out 2). Fix missing or extra marks before approving.
ackBlockedAdjustedNoRemarks: Adjusted days require remarks before approval.
ackBlockedMissingPunches: Working day without valid punches — register clock marks or add the missing punch in Adjust (In/Out). Hour-only edits without punches do not allow approval.
ackBlockedIncoherentTotals: Day totals do not match punches — save/recalculate before approving.
reviewBlockNotApprovable: {{count}} day(s) missing valid punches or incomplete — fix before continuing.
prePayrollPeriodRequired: Approve or lock the period before exporting pre-payroll.
reviewSelectEmployeeFirst: Select one employee (not "All") to submit or approve review.
reviewSubmitBlocked: Fix the listed issues before submitting.
reviewApproveBlocked: Fix the listed issues before approving.
reviewNotInReview: This employee is not in review.
reviewApproveNeedsEmployeeSign: The employee must sign the timesheet before approval.
reviewLockNotReady: Not all employees are approved yet.
reviewBlockIncomplete: {{count}} incomplete day(s) — recalculate or adjust before continuing.
reviewBlockAdjustedNoRemarks: {{count}} adjusted day(s) without remarks — add a reason.
reviewModalSubmitIntro: The manager will be notified to review and approve the timesheet. Employee acknowledgment happens on the payslip.
reviewModalApproveIntro: Approve {{name}}'s timesheet for this period? The monthly signature (selfie + rubric) is already on file.
reviewModalLockReadyIntro: All employees are approved. The period will be locked for payroll.
reviewModalLockForceIntro: Some employees are not approved yet. You can force lock if payroll must close.
reviewLockForceHint: Force lock prevents further edits even with pending items.
reviewSummaryHint: Employee signs in the mobile app; manager or HR approves after the monthly signature.
overtimeHint: OT = hours worked beyond the scheduled shift.
dataSourceBody: The mirror uses clock punches (PrintPoint/REP), not mobile selfie check-in. Sync under Organization → System → Clock sync, then click Recalculate period.
noPunchesDetail: No clock punches in this period. Collect via Clock sync or add a manual punch.
hasPunchesNoWork: {{count}} punches found but worked hours are zero — click Recalculate period or verify shift/employee ID (PIS).
revokeManagerAckOk: Approval undone — the day is editable again.
railSelectEmployee: Click a collaborator in the list to see hour bank and punches.
bankDisabledFrozenHint: Hour bank disabled in Organization → System. The balance is frozen (history) and overtime is now paid on payroll.
periodHoursHint: Sum of expected vs worked hours for elapsed days in this period.
noDays: No days calculated. Use Recalculate period.
punchesHint: Clock / manual punches for the selected day
mirrorNeedEmployee: The didactic mirror shows one employee's daily grid at a time. Choose an employee in the filters and click Apply filters.
adjustModalIntro: Add forgotten punches and let the system calculate hours. If you approved by mistake, use Undo approval.
adjustAckApprovedHint: To fix punches or totals, undo approval first.
adjustAckPendingHint: Check punches and calculated hours. If a punch is missing, add it above. If correct, approve the day.
adjustNeedUnapproveFirst: This day is approved. Click Undo approval to add punches or edit.
adjustSaveBeforeApprove: Save the hour adjustment before approving the day.
adjustSectionPunchesHint: Add a missing punch (e.g. clock-out at 17:45). The system recalculates worked time, OT, late and absence automatically.
adjustNoPunchesHint: No punches on this day — add clock-in/out manually below or sync the clock.
adjustAddPunchHint: Enter the time and whether it is in or out. Day hours recalculate immediately, then you can approve the day.
adjustPunchNotePlaceholder: Optional reason (e.g. forgot to clock out)
adjustPunchAddedRecalc: Punch added and day hours recalculated.
offerApproveDayAfterRecalc: Day hours recalculated. Approve this day now?
punchSavedRecalc: Punch saved and day hours recalculated.
adjustPunchDeletedRecalc: Punch removed and day hours recalculated.
adjustPunchDuplicate: A punch already exists at this time. Pick another time or remove the manual punch.
adjustDeletePunchConfirm: Remove this manual punch and recalculate the day hours?
adjustPunchUpdatedRecalc: Punch updated and day hours recalculated.
adjustApplyFixedBreakHint: Adds shift break start/end ({{start}}–{{end}}) as manual punches.
adjustApplyFixedBreakBlockedClock: A clock break already exists for this day — cannot replace it.
adjustApplyFixedBreakReplaceConfirm: A manual break already exists for this day. Replace it with the shift fixed window?
adjustFixedBreakApplied: Fixed break applied and day hours recalculated.
adjustFixedBreakUnavailable: This shift has no fixed break window configured.
adjustSectionCalculatedHint: Values computed automatically from clock + manual punches.
adjustSectionCalculatedReadOnlyHint: Live mirror of the calculation — edit punches in Step 1 to update these totals.
adjustRemarksOptionalHint: Optional — record a reason for punch adjustments (audit trail).
adjustIncoherentStoredHint: Saved numbers do not match the current calculation. Edit punches or recalculate the period; approval stays blocked until coherent.
adjustSectionValuesHint: Only if automatic calculation is still wrong after fixing punches. Use +/− 15 min or type hours/minutes.
adjustIgnorePunchHint: Clock punches are never deleted. Ignore for calculation to skip an accidental punch (e.g. double clock-in).
adjustPunchIgnoredRecalc: Punch ignored for calculation and day hours recalculated.
adjustPunchConsideredRecalc: Punch included again and day hours recalculated.
adjustRemarksPlaceholder: e.g. missed clock-out; partial medical leave; shift correction…
adjustNoChangesYet: Change at least one value to save.
adjustSavedNeedsReack: Hours saved. Day approval was cleared — approve again after reviewing.
